new_results.statement: For R=aX^2+X(2m^T Y+beta)+S(Y), with X an original cap-one coordinate independent of the original-product bank Y and m!=0, sup_z P(|R-z|<=eps)<=4*2^(1/4)||m||^(-1/2)sqrt(eps), uniformly in a,beta,S, signs and dimension.

An invertible indefinite original physical pair with D=|detB| and kappa=sigma_min(B), whose exact Schur residual contains an arbitrary-diagonal physical hub with cross row m!=0, has ||p_Q||_infinity<12.714 D^(-1/3)kappa^(-1/6)||m||^(-1/6).
The live exact-rank-three collar has sup_z P(|Q-z|<=eps)<6.729 sqrt(eps), 1/4-Hoelder coefficient <2.594 and quarter-Riesz <5.188; bounded density remains open.

partner_application.actual_inequality: For e^-8<=D_res<=1, 34*sqrt(log(e/D_res))<102 in its residual-diffuse exact-null-coloop scope; continuity holds there.

next_step: Retain a second original-product smoothing currency in the exact-rank-three small-Pluecker collar (indefinite pair, diffuse mixed-hub/Fresnel packet, or aggregate co-heavy bank) and combine it with the proved uniform sqrt-small-ball estimate to obtain O(eps) without conditioning away the star.
